title.ko: 전치와 초점: Such was · So great was · Little did he know · What matters is
title.en: fronting and focus structures: such was, so great was, little did he know, what matters is

explain.ko: 전치(fronting)는 강조하려는 요소를 문장 앞으로 보내는 구문이고, 초점 구문은 분열문(It was ... that ...), 의사분열문(What matters is ...)과 도치(Little did he know ..., Such was ...)를 포함합니다. 전치 구문에서는 보통 주어와 동사가 도치되어 격식 있는 문체를 만듭니다. 부정어(little, at no point, hardly)가 앞에 오면 도치가 일어나고, so/such + 형용사가 앞에 오면 정도의 강조를 나타냅니다. 지나치게 쓰면 부자연스러우니 핵심에만 쓰세요.
explain.en: Fronting moves the element to be stressed to the start of the clause; focus structures include cleft sentences (It was ... that ...), pseudo-clefts (What matters is ...) and inversions (Little did he know ..., Such was ...). Fronting often inverts subject and verb, giving a formal style. A negative adverb (little, at no point, hardly) triggers inversion, and so/such + adjective expresses degree. Use sparingly at key points.

notes.ko: 부정어가 앞에 오면 의문문처럼 조동사를 주어 앞에 둡니다.
notes.en: With a fronted negative, put the auxiliary before the subject.

notes.ko: 분열문은 강조하려는 요소만 It ... that 사이에 둡니다.
notes.en: In a cleft, only the stressed element goes between It ... that.

notes.ko: 지나친 사용은 문장을 어렵게 하므로 핵심에만 쓰세요.
notes.en: Overuse makes sentences hard to read; use at key points.

lines.t: To add emphasis to writing, you can use fronting and cleft sentences. For example, as in Such was his passion that everyone was moved, place the element to emphasise at the front. You can also highlight an element with It was ... that.

task.model: Such was his passion that the whole team was moved. Little did he know it would be a turning point. What matters is not the result but the process. It was that experience that changed him.

model_trans.ko: 그의 열정은 대단해서 팀 전체가 감동했습니다. 그는 그것이 전환점이 될 줄은 조금도 몰랐습니다. 중요한 것은 결과가 아니라 과정입니다. 그를 바꾼 것은 바로 그 경험이었습니다.
model_trans.en: Such was his passion that the whole team was moved. Little did he know it would be a turning point. What matters is not the result but the process. It was that experience that changed him.
